settings.label: Adapt to this device
settings.doc: auto | off | weather | ambient | tick | seconds-off | slow | solid | flat-ground | gradient-sky: auto (the default) gives things up only as the device needs to keep the clock right, in a fixed order: rain and snow in motion (weather), cloud and water motion (ambient), seconds (tick, then seconds-off), one picture a minute (slow), then the glass (solid), the landscape (flat-ground) and the sky (gradient-sky). A settings of a feature the device has given up has no effect until it can have it back. off turns the adapting off: everything chosen, whatever the device can keep up with (the clock may fall behind). A name holds the clock at that step and the ones before it

settings.label: When the device is slow, keep
settings.doc: auto | sharp | smooth: what a device that cannot keep up gives up first. sharp keeps the picture at the display's size (sharp digits) and draws the sky and landscape smaller; smooth shrinks the whole picture (a small LED panel). Automatic: sharp on a display, smooth on an LED panel. Either way the clock always shows the right time: below that the program gives up rain and snow in motion, cloud and water motion, seconds, then draws one picture a minute, then the glass, the landscape and the sky become solid digits, a flat ground and a gradient (the Raspberry Pi program; a browser always draws everything)

presets.name: Standard
presets.note: The default look: liquid glass, a live sky, following the sun.

presets.name: Bedside
presets.note: Calm and dim at night: no seconds, soft glow, slow clouds, screen stays on.

presets.name: Sunset watcher
presets.note: Countdowns to sunrise and sunset, with a touch more glow.

presets.name: LED panel
presets.note: 64 × 32 LED matrix with the countdown in pixels. Light on the battery.

presets.name: Weather watch
presets.note: Umbrella alert and sunrise / sunset countdowns.

presets.name: Everyday
presets.note: Bedside calm plus the weather watch: no seconds, soft glow, dims at night, screen on, umbrella alert, sunrise and sunset countdowns.

presets.name: Everyday, power saver
presets.note: Everyday as an LED panel with every battery-saver setting: still sky, flat colour, no plants, low quality, dimmer at night. The screen stays on, because it is a clock.

presets.name: Showcase
presets.note: Everything turned up: high quality, glowing glass, moving clouds.

presets.name: Battery saver
presets.note: Still sky, flat ink, no plants, dimmed at night, screen not forced on.
